output.advice: Redraw so the silhouette reads as a gull. Keep the head (44066) at top-left near (222,198) with a short beak, and run the string (42911) from the head up to the far end at (268,108) as a separate line. Make the breast (43109) the centre of a compact rounded body near (250,290), with the vent (42799) just below it near (290,320). Draw each wing as a broad tapered shape: left wing from the left shoulder (43813) out to the left wingtip (45336, near 163,334), with the inner edge (44659) on its upper side; right wing from the right shoulder (42313) through the middle (41325) to the right wingtip (40526, near 368,236). Fan the tail below the vent: the long centre streamer (42835) down to about (272,470), the right tail feather (41307) out to about (336,422), with the right tail base (42402) between them.
